articles.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
articles.snippet: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.

articles.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
articles.snippet: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

articles.title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
articles.snippet: Ledger’s Atom will run apps like WhatsApp and Instragram and let users switch between smartphone functions and a protected mode for managing digital assets.

articles.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to just above $80,000 as South Korea’s Kospi plunged 8%, while the CoinDesk 80 fell 2.2% and all but six CoinDesk 100 members declined.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin bounces back to $82,000 after first fall below $80,000 in one month
articles.snippet: Stocks also turned positive after big early losses, helped by sharply lower bond yields.
